description: device:pca9685@1 resolves to a registered hook, every layer terminal is a pin, and every rating a layer reads has its slot.
derivation: BUILTINS registers device:pca9685@1 as a netlist hook (src/sim/models/builtins.ts), so builtin-binds checks that make(params) returns the hook record. The register behaviour sits in class Pca9685 (src/lib/interp/devices.ts:104) and has no byte-level check here, because the golden harness binds register-map devices only.
